newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Lukewarm reception for Nigerian bottler results.
newsitem.headline: Lukewarm reception for Nigerian bottler results.

text.p: A six percent increase in half-year after-tax profits at Coca-Cola bottler Nigerian Bottling Company received a lukewarm reception on the stock exchange on Monday, traders said.
The shares gained 13 kobo to 28.72 naira after the company announced after-tax profits of 678.9 million naira to end-June against 637.8 million naira in the first half of 1995.
A company statement said it expected the same trend to continue in the second half of the year barring unforseen circumstances.
"Although turnover was higher there is no big increase in profits, it looks like declining profitability, especially if inflation is taken into account," one trader said.
Turnover was 8.4 billion naira against 7.9 billion naira in the same period of 1995.
After tax profits were further reduced by an undisclosed minority interest which took 47.6 million naira compared to 22.1 million in the same period last year.
